title: Panshi SceneSeedValidatedReceiptBodyV1
description: TBody of SceneSeedValidatedReceiptV1 = CrossContextReceiptEnvelopeV1<SceneSeedValidatedReceiptBodyV1> (system-design.md §12.2, sealed inside the single SERIALIZABLE `SealSceneSeedArtifact` transaction, alongside `SceneSeedValidated` and the normalized typed artifact candidate). Never contains its own envelope's bodyDigest, signature, append position, event ID/hash, domainAcceptedAt, or any other provenance field. The artifact this receipt accompanies cannot enter the scheduler or cognition yet.

sceneSeedId.description: The SceneSeed this validated receipt belongs to.

normalizedPayloadBodyDigest.description: Digest of the exact-bytes ValidatedSceneSeedPayloadV1 (the normalized, domainAcceptedAt-free candidate) sealed in the same SealSceneSeedArtifact transaction.

commandAdmissionBodyDigest.description: The bodyDigest of the CommandAdmissionReceiptBodyV1 that admitted this seed's originating scene_authorship command; the sole cross-reference Identity's QuotaConsumed step verifies against.

quotaWindowId.description: Echoes the same Asia/Taipei ISO quota window ID fixed by the referenced CommandAdmissionReceiptBodyV1; never recomputed here.

policyRevisionSetDigest.description: Digest over the full set of policy revisions (moderation, scheduler, template, rights, etc.) this seed was validated against.

templateRevision.description: The question_template_id's templateRevision consulted for a LEAVE_CANDIDATE_QUESTION seed, or null for ARRANGE_ENCOUNTER / PLACE_SEALED_PUBLIC_MATERIAL seeds that carry no template.

rightsSnapshotDigest.description: Digest of the immutable rights snapshot consulted for this seed (e.g. sealed public material rights, or public-location eligibility).

deadlineAt.description: The world scheduling deadline for this seed after domain acceptance. Not a wall-clock expiry on the receipt itself and not a competing switch against Identity's QuotaConsumed acknowledgement.
